/*
 * Java の見本
 */
package com.example.sample;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.Function;
import static java.lang.Math.max;

/** Javadoc {@link List} @param <T> 型 */
@SuppressWarnings({"unchecked", "rawtypes"})
public final class Box<T extends Comparable<? super T>> implements Iterable<T> {
    private static final long SERIAL = 0x1FL;
    private final List<T> items = new ArrayList<>();
    protected volatile int count = 0b1010;

    public Box(T... xs) { Collections.addAll(items, xs); }

    @Override
    public Iterator<T> iterator() { return items.iterator(); }

    public <R> Box<R> map(Function<? super T, ? extends R> fn) {
        var out = new Box<R>();
        for (T x : items) out.items.add(fn.apply(x));
        return out;
    }

    sealed interface Shape permits Circle, Square {}
    record Circle(double r) implements Shape {}
    record Square(double side) implements Shape {}

    static double area(Shape s) {
        return switch (s) {
            case Circle c -> Math.PI * c.r() * c.r();
            case Square q when q.side() > 0 -> q.side() * q.side();
            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("unknown: " + s);
        };
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        String text = """
            text block "quoted"
            """;
        char c = '\n'; float f = 1.5e-3f; int n = max(args.length, 1_000);
        synchronized (Box.class) { System.out.printf("%s %c %f %d%n", text, c, f, n); }
        label: for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (i % 2 == 0) continue label; }
    }
}
